- Goal: evaluate Redwood Inference for personalized customer support generation across Acme’s EU/US regions.
- Key success metrics: 95th perc. latency < 400ms for typical queries, cost target <$0.002/token, and no PII retention beyond session TTL.

Current scope we discussed:
- 2-week pilot (test traffic mirrored from support queue)
- Models: 13B instruction-tuned open model (quantized) + fallback smaller model for low-cost routing
- Data: anonymized transcripts, prefix caching enabled

Immediate asks / owners:
- Acme: please share procurement & legal contacts (name + email)  — Sasha and counsel were mentioned on the call (Sasha, can you confirm?).
- Redwood (Marissa): I attached a mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones and a sample SOW/MSA for legal review.
- Technical sync: Ben (cc’d) will set up a short infra/IT call to confirm VPC/network requirements.

Proposed dates:
- Pilot kickoff: target week of Mar 1 (flexible)
- Legal review completed: Mar 8

Attachments: Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (MAP with milestones & kickoffs)

If that looks right, can you confirm the procurement contact and whether Mar 1 still works for kickoff?

Neither option requires committing to billing yet — we can keep the pilot scoped and delay invoice until signatures are done. If procurement needs a specific PO or vendor form, Sasha, please share and I’ll loop in finance.
